pendingSeal.message: Certification of the boundary and topography by a Maryland licensed surveyor. The plan is complete and delivered; this is the review step that follows. The boundary shown is GIS, compiled rather than surveyed — in testing, county GIS was 4.3 ft off the surveyed line and a front setback flipped from compliant to non-compliant once corrected.
Read the footnotes on the dimensional table. A footnote can replace the printed value outright for a specific use or lot type.
Maryland surveyor-certified boundary and topographic survey (surveyor): GIS parcel geometry is preliminary and may be offset from surveyed boundaries. A permit submission needs certified geometry.
Tree canopy — Zone LTO-E is not listed in Subtitle 25 Division 3, Sec. 25-128 Table 1. Subtitle 25 Division 3, Sec. 25-128 Table 1.

Curb and gutter, Subtitle 23 Division 3, Sec. 23-135(a)(1): required where the MAJORITY of lots abutting the road front 100 ft or less. This lot fronts 394.96 ft. The majority is taken over every lot on the road rather than this one, so DPW&T confirms it; curb and gutter is drawn on that basis.

Sidewalk, Subtitle 23 Division 3, Sec. 23-135(c): a residential road takes a walk on ONE side (arterials and collectors take both). BALTIMORE is classified by the county centreline layer; where it is a local residential street ONE side is the requirement. WHICH side is DPW&T's at street construction permit, and where walks already exist on both sides they continue to the next intersection before transitioning.
Review and seal by the professionals responsible for each subject. The platform drafts a complete plan; the seal is a human act that follows delivery. Nothing here implies county approval.
